title: Ada and the Verdict
author: O. M. Coldharbour
blurb: Sebastian Hartwell, a small-town coroner who knows every grave by name, thought they had seen every way a life can end. But when twin letters arrive: one confessing, one promising more, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must close the one case everyone swore was closed for good, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
